title: Strategy-scoped defaults and deployed-key migration

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each selected strategy/alias gets matching path/model, explicit overrides win; other-strategy workspace/caller defaults never leak.
Preserve programmatic defaults and null/empty/presence; unconfigured secondary Claude and helper unset getter/model auto, same-strategy legacy precedence.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Binder/object test cases and forward-port parity

title: Grok default without strategy exclusivity

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper defaults grok-cli, grok-build alias equivalent; explicit selection preserves all five existing strategies/aliases.
Never replace selected Codex/Copilot/one-shot/hosted with Grok; delegated capability/policy denial explicit, no wrong executable.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Real delegated Grok/Codex and local five strategies

title: Full local/remote session substitution

acceptanceCriteria.text: Worker reuses selected CLI implementation/arguments/parser, no duplicated vendor pipeline or hosted/remote recursion dependency.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Worker composition and real local/remote parity

acceptanceCriteria.text: Initial read/stream, send/stream, escape, end/dispose, liveness and actual agent PID preserve batch/interactive semantics.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Real deterministic interactive fixture plus Grok/Codex batch

acceptanceCriteria.text: Cancellation/terminal races and stream abandonment cannot reexecute prompts; End/Dispose idempotent and await verified cleanup.
Result callbacks/parsed JSON/YAML/chunk caps preserved without duplicate delivery or unbounded capture.

title: Bounded delegated admission and helper reserve

acceptanceCriteria.text: Helper reserved lane stays available with general lane occupied; second same-lane session Busy immediately, no queue/retry, max two CLI invocations.
Disclose and require approval of open voice blocking general TODO/requirements/parser up to hard lifetime; bounded idle/hard deadlines, local concurrency unchanged.
Cleanup or policy mismatch disables affected admission; public caller cannot steal helper lane or execution identity.

title: Nuke-owned cross-platform state-preserving update

acceptanceCriteria.text: Windows updater unchanged; Linux RID/apphost and unsupported-platform preflight preserved; Nuke unprivileged build then fixed pkexec.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Windows job and Linux target staging

acceptanceCriteria.text: Preserve data/provider/unrelated YAML and exact Unix metadata/units/dropins/env/group/linger state in root-only archive.
Known prereq release/no pending migrations before stop; backup before replacement, worker before MCP; recover interrupted journal before new transaction.
Mock-first/full-unit gates complete; staging/production never accept health-only or incomplete helper, retain full phase-end review evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: TDD/regression plus actual helper UID/cleanup and HV

title: Shared strategy contracts and worker composition

acceptanceCriteria.text: Public strategy/session contracts in Common, SAME four CLI implementations in AgentExecution, aggregate Services hosted registration, CLI-only worker and nonrecursive decorator with XMLDocs/lifetime parity.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Concrete WorkerComposition test and real parity

title: Strict framed session and internal launch protocol

acceptanceCriteria.text: Versioned strict UTF8/duplicate/unknown/depth/replay limits and public/internal size headroom, base64 chunks, monotonic IDs and launch schemas defined, no raw public argv.

All session members, parsed body and exact output forwarding preserve selected behavior; concurrency/cancellation/expiry terminal order and batch cleanup receipt vs interactive nullable receipt defined.

title: Registry-first launch and verified process supervision

acceptanceCriteria.text: Broker fsync allocation before manager submission/resource creation, held Ready proc UID/PID/start/cgroup validation before ACK; crash pending-job recovery no local fallback.
Child exit then stop cgroup then drain/parse/delete before batch result; deadline/crash/disconnect cleans siblings; capture receipts before failed-unit reset; failed cleanup stops admission.

title: Root policy, peers, immutable execution and clean environment

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root-readable policy separate private server config; authenticated peer/socket inherited group before parse/admission; root policy validates profiles and canonical paths; reject env/secrets and public identity.
Root-owned hash-verified vendor snapshots and closure, clean approved PATH/tools, no target credentials copy or server hardening change; untrusted mutable config cannot broaden policy.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Actual Grok/Codex closure trace, real UID/hardening

title: Reserved/helper-general admission and bounded lifetimes

acceptanceCriteria.text: One helper and one general lane, authenticated caller maps lane; Busy no queue/retry, voice/general blocking explicitly approved; release slot only after verified cleanup and bounded idle/hard/op deadlines.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Concurrent true UID processes and lifetime receipts

title: Privileged release transaction separated from unprivileged Nuke

acceptanceCriteria.text: Nuke validated package invokes bounded fixed pkexec installer, creates verified root libexec/state ancestors, no root repo code/DB access, immutable source/runtime/policy manifest and unprivileged migration attestation.

Fsync state transitions/lock, worker-first enable, retained backup metadata, dual-slot installer/bootstrap recovery, reverse restore exactly known prior release; unsafe recovery stops admission/services.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Actual injected transitions and final transaction receipt
